scope: Ten completed zero-shot evaluations and first completed fresh-training runs; no fresh-training performance conclusion. Read-only data/source audit; no JAX backend or checkpoint pickle loaded.

zero_shot_aggregate.uncertainty: Sample SD (ddof=1), SE, and two-sided 95% Student-t mean intervals across independent training seeds. Null uncertainty for one seed. Evaluation episodes are averaged within each trained model, never counted as independent training seeds.

paired_vs_baseline.delta_definition: Candidate minus matched baseline; positive coverage is better.

restoration_implementation_review.evidence: zero-shot helper calls original.rebuild_and_restore before spacing factory; reconstructed original CUDA layouts equal prior checkpoint hashes; spaced reset resets base_box_size/base_box_padding before one coordinate scale; independent old/new reset audit records zero scaling error.

layout_alignment.note: The zero-shot and fresh screening collections intentionally differ in layout count and reset/action seeds. Each collection is internally paired. Fresh confirmation is planned on the same 64 reset/action keys as zero-shot; its eventual layout hash should equal the zero-shot hash.

curve_progress_definition: Final 400 actions minus preceding 400 actions, and endpoint action4000 minus action2000; positive values indicate additional observed progress, without claiming convergence.
